text:
marta: Noticed docs PR #4890 has inconsistent sample fields for POST /v1/generate. Samples use "result" but the service emits "responses" now. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4890
devon: Oof. Which SDK snippets are impacted? I vaguely recall the JS quickstart showing `maxTokens` too.
marta: JS and Go. JS snippet uses `maxTokens` (camelCase) in the example body, Go comment shows MaxTokens but runtime expects `max_new_tokens`.
devon: Can we standardize examples on snake_case for JSON and add a note explaining SDK language mappings?
ira: +1. Canonical JSON examples should be snake_case. SDK snippets can show idiomatic usage but should include a small remark like: // JSON property: `max_new_tokens`
sam: I can push a patch to the PR to replace `result`->`responses` in examples and update the JS/Go snippets. Also add a one-paragraph migration note in the reference page about the earlier `result` field.
docs-bot: CI check failed: examples/openapi/generate.yaml sample doesn't validate against components/schemas/GenerateResponse. Linter error: example.rootKeyMismatch -> expected "responses"
ira: Thanks bot. We'll update the OpenAPI samples and examples directory. Can someone grep for "result": across the repo?
devon: Running a quick search: found 6 occurrences (docs/samples, quickstarts, and one blog snippet). I'll open a follow-up PR to update the blog.
marta: For the SDK snippets: show both forms? I prefer showing the canonical server JSON only once, then for each language snippet a tiny inline mapping comment. Keeps canonical docs clean.
sam: Patch pushed: branch sam/generate-examples-fix. Changes: examples -> snake_case JSON, response sample uses "responses", and JS/Go snippets updated with mapping comments. PTAL @marta @ira
ira: Reviewed. Left two nits on wording. Also request: add a changelog bullet "docs: standardize generate response field names and request param casing"
devon: Agree on changelog. Also can we add a short unit in the docs CI that parses example JSON and compares top-level keys to schema properties? That would have caught `result` earlier.
marta: Good call. I'll add a docs-lint rule to fail if example keys don't match OpenAPI schema. I'll prototype it in infra/docs-lint tomorrow.
docs-bot: Update: PR #4890 now passes docs-lint on the branch. Preview: https://deploy-preview-4890--redwood-docs.netlify.app/reference/generate
sam: Merged after resolving wording nits. I've also added the migration note: "Old docs used `result`; use `responses` now. `result` will be accepted as an alias for 30 days."
ira: Please add a short SDK compatibility note in the SDK repo release notes so client teams aren't surprised.
marta: Filed a docs->sdk task: https://issues.redwood.ai/INFR-321. Assigning to SDK leads.
devon: Nice. Closing loop: blog PR and quickstart updated in follow-up. Good teamwork :clap:
